title: MSIT 2027 budget proposal for AI
summary: AI share of the Ministry of Science and ICT's 2027 budget proposal, approved by the Cabinet on 1 September 2026. MSIT's total proposal is KRW 29.6 trillion, up 24.5% on the 2026 supplementary budget. MSIT puts its AI budget at KRW 9.4 trillion, roughly 84% more than in 2026, covering AI data-centre solutions, physical AI foundation models, frontier AI data, GPU-based AI infrastructure and next-generation semiconductors. The proposal is before the National Assembly and may change before it is passed.
purpose: Proposed MSIT spending on AI transformation in 2027, including AI compute, frontier models, AI services and AI inclusion.
